CustomField.label: Predicate JSON
CustomField.description: Boolean predicate over answers: {"all":[...]} or {"any":[...]}, nesting allowed, leaves of the form {"field":k,"op":o,"value":v}. field is source, target, a slot key or a supplement key; op is eq/ne/lt/lte/gt/gte/in/not_in. A field with no answer makes its clause false -- a gate that fires on data nobody supplied reads as the tool guessing.
